notes.title: Freakout hotfix 6
notes.notes:
Today we just correct the achievement problem on Windows build.

Fewer and fewer bugs to correct ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Freakout hotfix 5
notes.notes:
For this new patch we had 4 news localizations ! Portuguese, German, Russian and Chinese !!!

We also correct some bugs on the Linux build.

Have fun :)

notes.title: Freakout hotfix 4
notes.notes:
We changed texts for customisation and weapons to a clearer version. For example, you can now know that the shield takes 20 seconds to reload!
It might be useful for the people who can count while playing :D 

We also corrected a few bugs :)

notes.title: Freakout hotfix 3
notes.notes:
Lot of improvements for this third patch :
- Added a visual effect to represent the bombman explosion range
- Added a display on the hud for the lift countdown
- Added a checkpoint after the final wave in the keys level
- Added UI sounds to the SFX volume
- Added a windowed option
- Jail level balancing
- Shotgun balancing
- Levels readibility
- Improved explosion particle
- Improved muzzle flash particle
- Improved Enemies visibility X
- Improved Crosshair visibility
- Improved low graphics readibility and legibility
- Corrected Input bug when exiting at the start of the tuto level
- Corrected bug that don't display some objects in low graphics mode
- Corrected input texts when playing with mouse
- Corrected some spawn bugs during dialogues
- Corrected several bugs in the final boss level

notes.title: Freakout hotfix 2
notes.notes:
We have worked to improve the shooting screenshakes. It is now more rough and nervous.

We have also added a visual effect to show you where the next enemy is going to spawn. No more unfair death from behind ;)

We hope you enjoy the new version!
